description:
Extensions of an installation: the manifest a jar on the classpath
        describes itself with (ExtensionManifest), the registry of what was
        found at start (ExtensionRegistry), the port that records whether an
        extension is switched on in a namespace (ExtensionActivationRepository)
        and the service that answers it. No framework and no storage — the
        loader and the adapters live in mc-extension (classpath, file, memory)
        and mc-extension-pg.
